text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian troops in Croatia are praised by head of U.N. peacekeeping force for crucial role in preserving peace.
- Crown Prince Hassan handed a letter by a visiting Sudanese envoy from his country's leader; Sudan praises Jordan for its stance in the ongoing conflict with rebels.

- European Union (EU) says a transitionary period is essential before the implementation of a recently initialled association accord with Jordan; the accord is due to come into effect on January 1999.
- King Hussein performs Eid al Adha (Moslem feast) prayers in the Hashimiyah mosque.
- Jordan seeks 120,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
- First shipment of Iraq bound cargo arrives in the Red Sea port of Aqaba.
- Islamic parliamentarians will meet in Jordan next June.
